}}'''Nadere''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Goshien]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nadere}}

== Appearance ==
She is 5'11" or 180cm tall and wide, "as close to stout as any Aiel came". She has pale hair and green eyes. She has a large bosom.

==Strength and Abilities==
Nadere can [[channel]] with a strength in the One Power of {{opsl|25}}. This is only around average compared to an [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|Aes Sedai]].

This strength is more than enough to open alone a gateway for [[Travel]]ing.

== Activities ==
She summons [[Elayne Trakand]] for her [[first-sisters|first-sister]] [[bonding]] ceremony with [[Aviendha]]. She tells her she must come naked and takes part in the ceremony.

She comes to summon Aviendha with the news that she is to leave with the rest of the [[Aiel]] from [[Caemlyn]].

Months later she [[Travel]]s with the rest of her clan to [[Arad Doman]], where the Aiel attempt to bring peace to the war torn country.

While there she gives Aviendha more and more meaningless punishments, in an attempt to make her stand up to the other Wise Ones.

It can be assumed that during the [[Last Battle]] she fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley along the other Wise Ones.
